basic_details.job_title: NIT Warangal Junior Research Fellow (Electrical Engineering) Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The National Institute of Technology Warangal (an Institute of National Importance under the Ministry of Education, Govt. of India) has invited applications for one Junior Research Fellow (JRF) post in the ARG-JBG project, funded by the Anusandhan National Research Foundation (ANRF). The fellowship pays Rs. 37,000 per month for the first two years and Rs. 42,000 per month for the third year, with HRA of 20% of monthly emoluments. Candidates need First Class with at least 60% aggregate marks or a CGPA of at least 6.5 on a 10-point scale in both B.Tech/BE (Electrical Engineering or Electrical an

age_limit.details: The age limit is 30 years. The age relaxation is as per norms and guidelines of the Institute. The notice does not print a cut-off date for counting age. | The notice does not specify any discipline-wise detail beyond the above; candidates can check the official notification for the full eligibility terms.

qualification.details: A strong background in Power Electronics. Familiarity with simulation tools such as MATLAB/Simulink and Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) simulation platforms, including OPAL-RT and dSPACE controllers, is an added advantage. Preference will be given to candidates with hands-on experience in power electronic converters for renewable energy systems and EV charging applications.

how_to_apply: Fill the application proforma attached to the advertisement (page 2 of the notice, Advt. No. NITW/EE/2026/BS/ANRF-JBG/JRF).
Enclose a brief resume / curriculum vitae / bio-data along with the application form.
Attach soft copies of the supporting documents, if applicable.
Combine the filled form and supporting documents into a single PDF.
Upload the PDF in the Google form linked in the notice by 09/12/2026, 11.59 pm.
Name, father's name, date of birth, sex, marital status and category (OC/OBC/SC/ST).
Educational qualifications: SSC, Intermediate, B.E./B.Tech, M.Tech. and Ph.D. with specialization, board/university, year of passing, class and percentage/CGPA.
GATE score earned (qualified), research/industrial/teaching experience, publications/conference participations and any other relevant information.
A declaration that the information is true and that the candidate is available for an ONLINE interview, if necessary.
Queries can be sent to [email protected] or [email protected].
important_instructions: The position is purely temporary. The application form must be filled and uploaded together with the supporting documents as a single PDF. HRA is not paid if hostel accommodation is given. Non-GATE candidates must clear the Institute PhD entrance examination to continue receiving the JRF fellowship. The declaration states that a candidature is liable to be cancelled if the information is found false or incorrect or any ineligibility is detected before or after the selection.

content_sections.heading: NIT Warangal Junior Research Fellow (JRF) at a Glance
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the application fee.

rows.details: NITW/SRIC/RS35051/2026 (the application form carries Advt. No. NITW/EE/2026/BS/ANRF-JBG/JRF)
ARG-JBG Project: Development of a Smart Next-Generation PV-Integrated Bidirectional EV Charging System for G2V/V2G Operation in Grid-Interactive Microgrids
Three years or till the closure of the project, whichever is earlier
Rs. 37,000 per month for the first two years and Rs. 42,000 per month for the third year

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The candidate must have obtained First Class with a minimum of 60% aggregate marks or a CGPA of at least 6.5 on a 10-point scale in both of the following: B.Tech/BE in Electrical Engineering or Electrical and Electronics Engineering, and M.Tech./M.E. in Power Electronics / Energy Systems / Electric Vehicle Technology / or any other closely related specialization relevant to the project. Preference will be given to GATE qualified candidates, but GATE is not essential. Non-GATE candidates will be required to clear the Institute PhD entrance examination to continue receiving the JRF fellowship. A strong background in Power Electronics. Familiarity with simulation tools such as MATLAB/Simulink and Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) simulation platforms, including OPAL-RT and dSPACE controllers, is an added advantage. Preference will be given to candidates with hands-on experience in power electronic converters for renewable energy systems and EV charging applications. The age limit is 30 years. The age relaxation is as per norms and guidelines of the Institute. The notice does not print a cut-off date for counting age. The notice does not specify any discipline-wise detail beyond the above; candidates can check the official notification for the full eligibility terms.

content_sections.heading: NIT Warangal Junior Research Fellow (JRF) Job Description
content_sections.text: Development, modelling, simulation, and experimental validation of a smart PV-integrated bidirectional EV charging system supporting G2V/V2G operation, power flow management, and intelligent energy management in grid-interactive microgrids.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for NIT Warangal Junior Research Fellow (JRF)
content_sections.text: Name, father's name, date of birth, sex, marital status and category (OC/OBC/SC/ST). Educational qualifications: SSC, Intermediate, B.E./B.Tech, M.Tech. and Ph.D. with specialization, board/university, year of passing, class and percentage/CGPA. GATE score earned (qualified), research/industrial/teaching experience, publications/conference participations and any other relevant information. A declaration that the information is true and that the candidate is available for an ONLINE interview, if necessary. Queries can be sent to [email protected] or [email protected] .

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The list of eligible candidates will be announced on the institute website and intimated via email or phone. Shortlisted candidates will have to attend an interview in OFFLINE/ONLINE mode. The interview date is not specified in the notice. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: The position is purely temporary. The application form must be filled and uploaded together with the supporting documents as a single PDF. HRA is not paid if hostel accommodation is given. Non-GATE candidates must clear the Institute PhD entrance examination to continue receiving the JRF fellowship. The declaration states that a candidature is liable to be cancelled if the information is found false or incorrect or any ineligibility is detected before or after the selection.

faq.question: Q1. How many Junior Research Fellow posts has NIT Warangal advertised?
faq.answer: NIT Warangal has advertised one Junior Research Fellow (JRF) post in the ARG-JBG project funded by ANRF.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the NIT Warangal JRF post?
faq.answer: The last date is 09/12/2026 (9 December 2026) at 11.59 pm.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for the NIT Warangal JRF post?
faq.answer: First Class with at least 60% aggregate marks or a CGPA of at least 6.5 on a 10-point scale in both B.Tech/BE in Electrical Engineering or Electrical and Electronics Engineering, and M.Tech./M.E. in Power Electronics, Energy Systems, Electric Vehicle Technology or a closely related specialization relevant to the project.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the NIT Warangal JRF post?
faq.answer: The age limit is 30 years, with relaxation as per norms and guidelines of the Institute.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of the NIT Warangal JRF?
faq.answer: The emoluments are Rs. 37,000 per month for the first two years and Rs. 42,000 per month for the third year.

faq.question: Q6. Is HRA paid on top of the emoluments?
faq.answer: HRA is 20% of monthly emoluments, but no HRA is paid if hostel accommodation is given.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply for the NIT Warangal JRF post?
faq.answer: Fill the application proforma attached to the notice, add a brief resume and supporting documents, and upload everything as a single PDF in the Google form given in the notice.

faq.question: Q8. Is GATE compulsory for the NIT Warangal JRF post?
faq.answer: No. Preference is given to GATE qualified candidates, but GATE is not essential. Non-GATE candidates must clear the Institute PhD entrance examination to continue receiving the JRF fellowship.

faq.question: Q9. How are candidates selected for the NIT Warangal JRF post?
faq.answer: The list of eligible candidates is announced on the institute website and intimated by email or phone, and shortlisted candidates attend an interview in OFFLINE/ONLINE mode.

faq.question: Q10. Is the NIT Warangal JRF post permanent?
faq.answer: No. The notice says the position is purely temporary, lasting three years or till the closure of the project, whichever is earlier.
